claim_scope: preregistered finite conditional-regret stress test under deterministic stationary synthetic profiles

score.sdk_raw: Q=sum of SDK predicate severity weights plus 2 times unique non-null score-cell hashes
score.candidate: q_z(m)=16*e_z(m)+2 for e_z(m)>0; zero and no finding for e_z(m)=0

exact_numeric_model.parameter_generation: CPython math.log/exp and random.Random produce float a,b,d,lambda exactly as frozen; those realized binary floats define the finite estimand.
exact_numeric_model.parameter_storage: Store every present parameter with float.hex(); absent lambda is literal NA.
exact_numeric_model.cost_conversion: Convert a,b,d with fractions.Fraction.from_float. Define primary cost cF(m)=aF+bF*m+dF*m*m and negative cost cF(m)=bF*m exactly as Fraction; never compute resource capacities from float costs.
exact_numeric_model.resource_arithmetic: Represent B_gen and B_rep as Fraction(integer,1), sum probe costs as Fraction, divide Fractions, and use math.floor only on Fraction. Store every cost/resource as coprime numerator and positive denominator.
exact_numeric_model.event_arithmetic: For a cliff profile, e_z(m) is the integer floor of the frozen CPython float expression m*math.exp(-lambda*(m-k)/k), then clamped. Negative profiles have e_z(m)=m and use no exp.
exact_numeric_model.negative_exactness: Because bF is a positive exact Fraction and cF(m)=m*bF, T=8100/bF-87 is exact rational. All capacity floors and the m=1 inequality are exact integer/rational operations.

finding_construction.candidate_id: lowercase SHA256 hex of UTF-8 preimage
assertions: every predicate is EXFILTRATION severity integer 5
retained hashes are unique within policy/profile
SDK raw equals summed q before saturation

primary_split.draw_order: fresh keyed PRNG; draw a,b; draw d only for high curvature; draw lambda only for cliff != -1; no other draw or rejection
primary_split.events: m when cliff=-1 or m<=cliff; else clamp(floor(m*exp(-lambda*(m-cliff)/cliff)),0,m)
primary_split.weighting: all profiles weight equally; equivalently each stratum 1/40 and each replicate 1/8; every stratum reported; no substitute weighting
primary_split.scope: designed stress support; only realized within-cell binary-float parameters are held out; no prevalence claim

negative_split.draw_order: fresh keyed PRNG; first/only draw b=log_uniform(5.0,12.0); a=d=0; lambda absent; cliff=-1
negative_split.global_policy: select PROBE_GLOBAL_NEGATIVE independently on these 64 profiles
negative_split.required_result: m=1 for adaptive and global; exact aggregate difference 0

probe_and_fill.probe_rule: attempt one each; generation charges every exact cF; replay/candidate/raw charge only positive e
probe_and_fill.summary: gF=sum all probe cF; p=count positive e; rF=sum positive-e cF; Q=sum positive-e q
probe_and_fill.fill_capacity: for q>0 n=max(0,min(2000-p,floor((B_gen-gF)/cF),floor((B_rep-rF)/cF),0 if Q>=200000 else ceil((200000-Q)/q))); q=0 gives n=0
probe_and_fill.probe_global_primary: argmax_m sum over primary S_probe,z(m), ties smaller length
probe_and_fill.probe_global_negative: argmax_m sum over negative S_probe,z(m), ties smaller length

other_controls.static0: for q>0 n=min(2000,floor(B_gen/cF),floor(B_rep/cF),ceil(200000/q)); score=min(200000,n*q); zero for q=0
other_controls.oracle0: per-profile best static0, ties smaller length
other_controls.static0_global_primary: primary aggregate best static0, ties smaller length
other_controls.mixed8_class: all weak integer compositions h of 8 across lengths
other_controls.mixed8_cycle: at slot t=0..7 choose, among count_m<h_m, maximum (t+1)*h_m-8*count_m, ties smaller length
other_controls.mixed8_execution: repeat fixed cycle; exact Fraction resources; zero-event attempt consumes generation only; stop before successful attempt that exceeds candidate/replay; retain first saturation-crossing success
other_controls.mixed8_selection: maximize primary aggregate, tie to lexicographically smallest tuple (h_1,h_2,h_4,h_8,h_16,h_24,h_32)

metrics_and_decision.S_global_D: sum primary PROBE_GLOBAL_PRIMARY integer objectives; positive because m=1 probe succeeds
metrics_and_decision.materiality_prediction: CONFIRMED iff protocol valid and 100*primary_gain_numerator>=5*primary_gain_denominator; otherwise DISCONFIRMED for every valid sub-5% result
metrics_and_decision.contrast_subtype: ZERO iff numerator=0; POSITIVE_SUBTHRESHOLD iff 0<100*numerator<5*denominator; MATERIAL iff 100*numerator>=5*denominator
metrics_and_decision.negative_check: adaptive negative aggregate minus PROBE_GLOBAL_NEGATIVE aggregate is integer 0

canonical_serialization.tsv: UTF-8, LF, tabs, exact header/order, no embedded tabs/newlines
canonical_serialization.integer: base-10 without leading zeros except zero
canonical_serialization.fraction: coprime base-10 numerator and positive denominator
canonical_serialization.percent_fixed_12: with localcontext(prec=80,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN), quantize Decimal(100)*Decimal(numerator)/Decimal(denominator) to Decimal('0.000000000001'), then format(value,'f'); exactly 12 fractional digits

enums_and_sentinels.policy_parameter: selected/fixed length integer for all policies except MIX8_GLOBAL_PRIMARY; -1 for MIX8; seven h columns encode its tuple
enums_and_sentinels.fill_length: selected fill length integer for probe policies; -1 for STATIC0, ORACLE0, and MIX8

row_schemas.profiles_types: enum strings as declared; profile/stratum/cliff/replicate/policy_parameter/h/fill/count/raw are integers; *_hex are float_parameter; *_num integers; *_den positive integers. Negative stratum/replicate are -1, bands/lambda are NA. Non-MIX h columns are -1.
row_schemas.candidate_types: indices/cost_num/event/predicate/raw integers; cost_den positive; attempted/retained literal true|false; candidate_id 64 lowercase hex; score_cell_hash same when retained else NA; enums declared
row_schemas.row_order: primary profiles 0..319 each in primary_policy_order; then negative 0..63 each in negative_policy_order; candidate rows same order then ordinal; mixture profiles lexicographically smallest-to-largest h then profile 0..319; mixtures same h order

randomness.target: anchor_unix_ms+1440*60000; exact returned parsed unix_ms must equal target

prediction_ledger.freeze: rows each occur once unresolved; FREEZE records whole-file SHA256; pre-outcome checks require exact hash
prediction_ledger.valid_resolution: After outputs validate, primary metric_value=summary.primary_gain.percent_fixed_12, signal=confirm iff materiality_prediction CONFIRMED else disconfirm, status=keep iff CONFIRMED else discard. Negative metric_value=decimal negative_difference_integer, signal=confirm, status=keep. Preserve predicted columns/descriptions and NA memory/runtime.
prediction_ledger.invalid_resolution: For both rows metric_value=NA, signal=null, status=crash; preserve all predicted columns/descriptions.
prediction_ledger.timing: No results.tsv mutation before summary validation. Immediately afterward resolve both rows once, append outcome and Prediction-vs-Reality to a new research log, append progress, and explicitly commit results.tsv, log, progress, and all terminal artifacts. The frozen pre-run blob remains addressable at implementation commit I and by hash in FREEZE.

custody_state_machine.IMPLEMENTED_to_FROZEN: From clean HEAD=I and matching hashes, fetch/preserve exact HTTP response bytes at freeze-anchor.raw.json, validate against artifact-schema nistPulseEnvelope, set target, atomically create FREEZE.json against artifact-schema freeze; commit exactly the two files as F with parent I.
custody_state_machine.FROZEN_to_ACKNOWLEDGED: Post exact F/hash/target in this user thread before target; require exact ACK; preserve USER_ACK.txt and create PUBLICATION.json against schema; commit exactly both as A with parent F.
custody_state_machine.ACKNOWLEDGED_to_PULSE_PRESERVED: From clean HEAD=A and exact I-F-A chain/hashes, fetch target after its time, validate bytes in memory including parsed exact target, then atomically write those exact bytes to revealed-pulse.raw.json. If any prior step fails, create ABANDONED from ACKNOWLEDGED. Once raw exists, no invocation may fetch again.
custody_state_machine.PULSE_PRESERVED_to_OPENED: Parse only preserved raw bytes, derive master in memory, atomically create complete OPENED.json including master_digest_hex against schema. Failure/crash is terminal; next invocation creates ABANDONED with last state PULSE_PRESERVED and does not resume.
custody_state_machine.OPENED_to_EVALUATION_STARTED: Atomically create EVALUATION_STARTED.json against schema. Failure/crash is terminal; next invocation creates ABANDONED with last state OPENED and does not resume.
custody_state_machine.EVALUATION_STARTED_to_COMPLETED: Only after both ledgers exist and validate may any profile substream be created. Evaluate primary+negative, write all outputs/summary. Crash is terminal; next invocation creates ABANDONED with last state EVALUATION_STARTED and never reruns.
custody_state_machine.terminal_rule: ABANDONED and COMPLETED are terminal. One FREEZE, one target fetch, one OPENED creation, one evaluation start, zero retry/substitution. Each artifact uses exclusive atomic create. No two-file atomicity is claimed.
custody_state_machine.publication: F/hash/target posted in shared user thread and exact pre-target user ACK committed; future user checkpoint, not current external-action authorization

raw_pulse_artifacts.freeze_anchor: freeze-anchor.raw.json is the exact nonempty HTTPS response byte sequence, unchanged including whitespace, whose SHA256 FREEZE records; parsed JSON must validate #/$defs/nistPulseEnvelope.
raw_pulse_artifacts.revealed_pulse: revealed-pulse.raw.json is the exact nonempty HTTPS response byte sequence, unchanged including whitespace, whose SHA256 OPENED records; parsed JSON must validate #/$defs/nistPulseEnvelope and parsed time must equal target.
raw_pulse_artifacts.no_rewrite: Raw artifacts use atomic exclusive creation and are never canonicalized, reformatted, truncated, or replaced.

failure_semantics.shared: preserve partial artifacts/data, create schema-valid ABANDONED when possible, protocol invalid/not evaluable, no all-policy zeroing or retry
failure_semantics.policy_specific: affected profile/policy score zero with POLICY_ERROR; unaffected rows computed; protocol invalid/not evaluable

outputs.schemas: JSON artifacts validate the named $defs in artifact_schema; TSV and cross-field constraints validate against this contract; selected h sum must equal 8; all failure error-code keys are emitted including zeros
